outlets.name: VnExpress (Du lich / Doi song)
outlets.credible: Vietnamese-language; Vietnam's most-read online newspaper. Its Du lich and Doi song desks run reported, bylined food features on named HCMC eateries (history, address, owner). Includes the Ngoi sao sub-site (ngoisao.vnexpress.net).

outlets.name: Ngoi Sao (ngoisao.vnexpress.net)
outlets.credible: Vietnamese-language lifestyle title within the VnExpress group; editorial food roundups and single-shop features on Saigon institutions.

outlets.name: Thanh Nien (Am thuc)
outlets.credible: Vietnamese-language; major national daily. Its Am thuc / Sai Gon tiem xua quan cu series does deep, reported profiles of decades-old Saigon street-food institutions with owner interviews and addresses.

outlets.name: Nguoi Lao Dong
outlets.credible: Vietnamese-language; established HCMC daily (Nguoi Lao Dong). Food and travel desks cover long-standing local eateries; used only for editorial articles, never listings.

outlets.name: ZNews / Zing (Lifestyle - Dia diem an uong)
outlets.credible: Vietnamese-language; licensed news site (formerly Zing). Its Lifestyle food desk publishes curated, reported HCMC eatery features and named-shop roundups (lifestyle.znews.vn).

outlets.name: Kenh14
outlets.credible: Vietnamese-language youth news/culture site with very large reach; reported street-food features naming specific Saigon stalls, their history and owners. Editorial articles only.

outlets.name: Michelin Guide Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City)
outlets.credible: Institutional authority. Michelin Guide has covered HCMC since 2023 (Bib Gourmand / Selected / Stars); a lone Bib/Selected/Star listing satisfies the merit bar on its own. Referenced via credible outlets' coverage in this pass.
